q: What makes up the carbon footprint of epoxy resin?
title: Epoxy resin carbon footprint per kg
short: Raw materials dominate: bisphenol A and epichlorohydrin, both made from petrochemicals, with chlorine in epichlorohydrin. The resin plant's own fuel and power are a smaller part. Ask suppliers for cradle to gate figures per kg and report purchased resin in Scope 3 Category 1.
audience: Paint, adhesive and composite makers buying epoxy

ul: Bisphenol A and epichlorohydrin bought, per kg of resin.
Steam and electricity for reaction and solvent recovery.

p: Use the supplier's cradle to gate figure where you have one, with its date and method. Where you do not, a secondary factor is an estimate and should be labelled as one.

senseible: Senseible reads your electricity bills, fuel invoices and purchase invoices into dated, fingerprinted records, so a per unit footprint can be traced back to the documents behind it. Estimates are labelled as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
